method: Existing Engine::run completed-dispatch count, plus local opcode/origin counters, recorded once per program invocation; called and looped function bodies expand dynamically. Initial-program attribution separates Font/ControlValue/Glyph; source-origin attribution identifies called fpgm code during Glyph execution. Builder preparation and warmup recorded separately, then reset before each single glyph. Per-case means over unique profile glyphs; profile/DPR overview is median across five logical sizes. No performance numbers, cache overhead estimates, or program-count performance predictions. PUSH operands, skipped branch/function-definition scanning, point loops inside an opcode, scratch setup, memory copies, parsing and rasterization are not separate dispatched instructions.
